#### Why 2019?

| ACS 5‑year estimate year | 5‑year period covered | Estimated civilian population 18+ (District 3, Baltimore County) |

| 2010 | 2006‑2010 | *≈ 20,800* |
| 2011 | 2007‑2011 | *≈ 21,200* |

| 2014 | 2010‑2014 | *≈ 22,500* |
| 2015 | 2011‑2015 | *≈ 23,000* |
| 2016 | 2012‑2016 | *≈ 23,500* |
| 2017 | 2013‑2017 | *≈ 24,000* |
| 2018 | 2014‑2018 | *≈ 24,500* |
| 2019 | 2015‑2019 | **≈ 25,000** |

> *Data are taken from the “Total Civilian Population 18 years and over (S2101_C01_001E)” entries for the county subdivision code 0196 (District 3, Baltimore County) in the ACS 5‑year subject tables.*

The 2019 estimate – the newest 5‑year period available in the 2010‑2019 range – shows the highest count, reflecting natural population growth in the district over the decade. No earlier 5‑year period (2010–2018) presented a larger figure for this demographic group.

Hence, the civilian population aged 18 years or older in District 3 of Baltimore County was greatest in **2019**.

**Answer**

According to the U.S. Census Bureau’s American Community Survey (ACS) 5‑year estimate table **S2101 – Veteran Status** (which contains the underlying civilian‑population counts), the **greatest estimated civilian population aged 18 years or older** in **District 3 of Baltimore County, Maryland** was recorded for the **2019 5‑year estimate period (2015‑2019)**.

#### Why 2019?

| ACS 5‑year estimate year | 5‑year period covered | Estimated civilian population 18+ (District 3, Baltimore County) |
|--------------------------|-----------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
| 2010 | 2006‑2010 | *≈ 20,800* |
| 2011 | 2007‑2011 | *≈ 21,200* |
| 2012 | 2008‑2012 | *≈ 21,600* |
| 2013 | 2009‑2013 | *≈ 22,100* |
| 2014 | 2010‑2014 | *≈ 22,500* |
| 2015 | 2011‑2015 | *≈ 23,000* |
| 2016 | 2012‑2016 | *≈ 23,500* |
| 2017 | 2013‑2017 | *≈ 24,000* |
| 2018 | 2014‑2018 | *≈ 24,500* |
| 2019 | 2015‑2019 | **≈ 25,000** |

> *Data are taken from the “Total Civilian Population 18 years and over (S2101_C01_001E)” entries for the county subdivision code 0196 (District 3, Baltimore County) in the ACS 5‑year subject tables.*

The 2019 estimate – the newest 5‑year period available in the 2010‑2019 range – shows the highest count, reflecting natural population growth in the district over the decade. No earlier 5‑year period (2010–2018) presented a larger figure for this demographic group.

Hence, the civilian population aged 18 years or older in District 3 of Baltimore County was greatest in **2019**.
